title: The Appalachians
description: The whole Appalachian range, Georgia to Newfoundland: its regions, named ranges, high peaks, and both Appalachian Trails, with 3D terrain.

title: PocketTiles Studio
description: Draw on a map or drop in a GeoJSON file, then bake it into a PMTiles map archive right in the browser. No tile server needed.

title: Orbit to Street
description: One to-scale 3D scene from 40,000 km out to Boston and Lynn rooftops. Population bars flatten into the land as you descend, buildings rise, and the real sun sets the day, night and shadows for any date and time.

title: Category Five
description: Thirty-two chaotic party games on one screen, against friends or bots. Flag Snap, Castle Siege, Tilt Sumo, Vault Heist, Block Brawl, and a lot more.

title: Flag Snap
description: Flag memory with a twist: match pairs on your turn, or snap a rival's pair from the sidelines.

title: Parrot Flip
description: Flick a pirate macaw and land it standing on a perch that moves every flip.

title: Castle Siege
description: Hide your king, build your walls, then trade cannon fire. First to two rounds wins.

title: Lucky Drop
description: Everyone drops the same orbs on the same beat onto their own board. Overflow and you bust.

title: Stormbolt
description: Slingshot pucks into the eye of the storm. Run out and you call down lightning on everyone else's.

title: Booty Haul
description: Raid shipping lanes on the globe, fill your hold, and haul it home before the navy finds you.

title: Chaos Derby
description: Bet on one of six weird runners in a physics race, hedge at the halfway bell, and cheer once.

title: Bug Wars
description: Turn-based bug territory with dice: capture a stack, then surge for more or bank what you have.

title: Kaboom Isle
description: Artillery on crumbling islands where everyone fires at once and the lava keeps rising.

title: Vault Heist
description: Fling your ball to grab coins, ram rivals to steal theirs, and bank it all in the roaming vault.

title: Bonk
description: Bonk critters in your zone. The longer you wait, the more they pay, until they duck.

title: Sky Dash
description: Tap to climb through gates and grow a multiplier. Bank the run, or ride it and risk the crash.

title: Drop Zone
description: Four in a row scores, then the board tilts and everything slides.

title: Curve Clash
description: Your line never stops. Loop it closed to claim the ground inside and trap anyone caught there.

title: Tower Topple
description: Everyone stacks one shared tower while the others try to blow your block off line.

title: High Noon
description: A standoff: tap the instant DRAW! appears, and double down between rounds if you dare.

title: Rope Riot
description: One player spins, everyone else jumps. Bank your pot or get swept and lose it to the spinner.

title: Chomp
description: Chomp marbles, then hold still to swallow them before a bomb makes you lose the lot.

title: Block Brawl
description: Falling-blocks versus with the same pieces for everyone. Your clears send garbage to rivals.

title: Dare Dash
description: A red-light, green-light sprint: mash on green, freeze on red, and gamble on yellow.

title: Big Blast
description: Five plungers, one live. Every dud grows your stake, so stop and bank or press your luck.

title: Hold It!
description: Pass the bomb before the hidden fuse runs out. Hold it longer to make it stick to the catcher.

title: Flag Flash
description: Red flag, blue flag, both, or neither: tap the right side before the window closes.

title: Tilt Sumo
description: Heavy balls on a tipping ring. Steer, slam, and push everyone else off the edge.

title: Thin Ice Stampede
description: Hop ice lanes to dodge sliding herds, but stand still too long and the ice gives way.

title: Hot Tiles
description: A color is called and every other tile drops into the lava. Get on the right one in time.

title: Slot Hop
description: Slot-car racing: hold to throttle, tap to switch lanes, and shunt the car ahead into a spin.

title: Smudge Race
description: Trace the same squiggle in one stroke. Finish first and smudge ink over everyone else's path.

title: Mug Shots
description: Pull a rubber face into the target expression. Snap it early for a bigger bonus.

title: Avalanche Luge
description: Side-by-side sled runs: draft, tuck, and stay ahead of the avalanche.

title: Hive Heist
description: Take honey from a comb that hides wasps, and bank it before a sting spills it all.

title: Micro Mayhem
description: Fifteen four-second microgames back to back. Build a streak and jinx the leader.

title: Population Relief Globe
description: Where the world lives: 2025 population density as 105,700 bars on a globe. Tilt toward the horizon, search any city, and watch the Ganges plain tower.

title: Hurricane Globe
description: Every hurricane, typhoon and cyclone on record, in every ocean, on a 3D globe. Tracks rise with wind speed. Replay any season with live wind fields, map storm density, or list every storm that passed near your town.

title: Boston Massing Model
description: Downtown Boston in 3D: every OpenStreetMap building raised to its recorded height, towers built from their mapped parts, with streets, parks, and the harbor.

title: State Puzzle
description: The 50 states shuffled into one random continent with the borders erased and the cities left behind. Draw the old state lines back on.

title: National Park Explorer
description: Every National Park Service unit on one map. Click a park for when it was created, how big it is, and how many people visited last year.

title: World XI
description: A globe of more than 5,000 soccer clubs, each sitting on its home stadium.

title: The Century of Africa
description: Africa's population will roughly triple this century. This story map asks whether power, water, and roads will keep up.

title: Torn Down / Built Back
description: Which Detroit blocks were torn down and which were built back, from 1870 to now.

title: Train Route Atlas
description: Twelve famous train routes on a spinning globe, with a short note on each.

title: State Extremes
description: The northernmost, southernmost, easternmost, and westernmost points of every US state and every country.

title: Geopuesto Playground
description: A sandbox for drawing shortest paths and other curves on a globe.

title: U.S. Fantasy Transit Network
description: A made-up US transit map that connects cities at four scales, from coast-to-coast down to commuter.

title: Concord Civil War
description: A story map about an imagined civil war that splits Concord, New Hampshire along the river.

title: Bug Wars
description: Build a bug colony and try not to get eaten.

title: Bottle Game
description: Flick a bottle for a clean flip. Land it upright to steal a life. Win a game and unlock the parrot.

title: Whydah's Voyage
description: Sail Black Sam Bellamy's 1717 trip from the Caribbean to Maine. Ten missions, then the storm that sank the ship.

title: True Scale
description: See how big a place really is when you move it to another latitude.

title: Sequential Interstate Challenge
description: A driving order for every two-digit Interstate that cuts most of the extra connecting miles.

title: Mapzimus Board
description: A scoreboard of about 20,000 map ideas, ranked by how well they might travel.

title: Motion
description: Everything moving across New England, New York, and New Jersey right now: trains, subways, buses, ferries, ships, planes, and bikes, plus road cameras and weather, on one live map with a 3D view.

title: Where the Games Go
description: Where North Shore Nostalgia eBay packages have gone, drawn as routes from Salem.

title: Predicting Tomorrow's Housing Crisis
description: A work-in-progress map of Massachusetts housing pressure, with sliders you can move.

title: LEHS Math
description: The math site I built for Lynn English High School. Student and teacher pages, thirty-plus tools, and the MCAS question bank.

title: WhydahStory
description: The Whydah Gally for the classroom. The ship, the wreck off Cape Cod, the maps, and the people.

title: MathDOKtor
description: A site about depth of knowledge in math class. How hard a question really is, not just whether the answer is right.

title: howe2math
description: Printable Pre-Algebra, Algebra 1, and Geometry worksheets. Two minutes, then print.

title: Tappymaps Arcade
description: Color US states and counties, then play geography games on the same maps.

title: Citynario
description: A Lynn planning toy. Change a budget or a rule and see what that does to the city.

title: Ground Truth
description: Terrain notes for wooded land. Public data, drone lidar, and a map you can use before you buy or build.

title: Quabbin
description: The Quabbin Reservoir and the towns it drowned, with pictures, a fill animation, and a lidar view of what's left on the ground.

title: LEHS Data Dive
description: Lynn school data next to peer districts, using state education numbers.

title: Elevation Studio
description: A 3D terrain workshop. Load real hills, trace rivers, and flood a valley. Still being built.

title: Optitrek
description: Twelve road-trip maps from a route optimizer: the fastest drives through America's national parks, including a loop that beats Randal Olson's famous 2015 trip by 14% in driving time.

title: Hurricane Impact Lab
description: A what-if hurricane map. Drop a storm on a city and see a story version and a numbers version. Still being built.

title: Vacation Selector
description: A short quiz that picks a trip from about 85 places.

title: Game Vault
description: Every North American release on 19 old consoles, with box art, so you can build a list and watch the disk space.
